examples.en: Their journey across the desert became an epic adventure.
examples.zh: 他们穿越沙漠的旅程成了一场史诗般的冒险。

examples.en: That clever rogue tricked many people out of their money.
examples.zh: 那个狡猾的恶棍骗走了许多人的钱。

examples.en: He tried to seduce her with sweet words and gifts.
examples.zh: 他试图用甜言蜜语和礼物来引诱她。

examples.en: Her amazing talent never fails to amaze the audience.
examples.zh: 她惊人的才华总是让观众感到吃惊。

examples.en: The sports car zoomed past us on the highway.
examples.zh: 那辆跑车在高速公路上从我们身边飞驰而过。

examples.en: She gently coaxed the frightened child to come down.
examples.zh: 她温柔地哄着那个受惊的孩子下来。

examples.en: His entrepreneurial spirit helped him start three companies.
examples.zh: 他的创业精神帮助他创办了三家公司。

examples.en: The cleric led the morning prayers at the church.
examples.zh: 那位教士在教堂里主持早晨的祈祷。

examples.en: Music can have a strong affective influence on people.
examples.zh: 音乐能对人产生强烈的情感影响。

examples.en: It's a nice day today, eh?
examples.zh: 今天天气不错，是吧？

examples.en: The actor wore a long black wig for the play.
examples.zh: 那位演员为这出戏戴了一顶长长的黑色假发。

examples.en: The young climber reached the top of the mountain.
examples.zh: 那位年轻的登山者到达了山顶。

examples.en: These rules set a normative standard for all members.
examples.zh: 这些规则为所有成员设定了一个规范的标准。

examples.en: They plan to renovate the old house next summer.
examples.zh: 他们计划明年夏天翻修这座老房子。

examples.en: A small mutation in the gene caused the disease.
examples.zh: 基因里一个小小的突变导致了这种疾病。

examples.en: People were shocked by the brutality of the attack.
examples.zh: 人们对这次袭击的残忍感到震惊。

examples.en: The new policy was popular with the entire electorate.
examples.zh: 这项新政策受到全体选民的欢迎。

examples.en: The workers brought their grievance to the manager.
examples.zh: 工人们把他们的不满向经理提了出来。

examples.en: We watched a bright meteor flash across the night sky.
examples.zh: 我们看着一颗明亮的流星划过夜空。

examples.en: The temperature dropped to minus five degrees last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚气温降到了零下五度。

examples.en: She pulled the reins to stop her horse.
examples.zh: 她拉紧缰绳让她的马停下来。

examples.en: His quick recovery attests to the doctor's skill.
examples.zh: 他迅速康复证明了那位医生的医术。

examples.en: The old man was hospitalized with severe pneumonia.
examples.zh: 那位老人因严重肺炎住进了医院。

examples.en: An eyewitness described the accident to the police.
examples.zh: 一名目击者向警方描述了这场事故。

examples.en: The new product was commercially very successful.
examples.zh: 这款新产品在商业上非常成功。

examples.en: Warm air flows through the duct into each room.
examples.zh: 暖空气通过管道流入每个房间。

examples.en: Washing your hands removes many harmful pathogens.
examples.zh: 洗手能去除许多有害的病原体。

examples.en: Each fingerprint is uniquely different from all others.
examples.zh: 每个指纹都与其他所有指纹独特地不同。

examples.en: The baby slept peacefully in her wooden cradle.
examples.zh: 婴儿在她的木制摇篮里安静地睡着。

examples.en: The monarch ruled the country for fifty years.
examples.zh: 这位君主统治了这个国家五十年。

examples.en: The captain stood at the helm during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中船长一直站在舵旁掌舵。

examples.en: We watched an exciting thriller at the cinema last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我们在电影院看了一部惊险刺激的惊悚片。

examples.en: She squeezed the orange until it became soft pulp.
examples.zh: 她把橙子挤压成了软软的果肉浆。

examples.en: The young man tried hard to woo his neighbor.
examples.zh: 那个年轻人努力地向他的邻居求爱。

examples.en: The angry child began to stomp his feet loudly.
examples.zh: 那个生气的孩子开始大声地跺脚。

examples.en: The cold air made his nostrils feel a bit numb.
examples.zh: 冷空气让他的鼻孔感觉有点麻木。

examples.en: He turned the crank to lift the heavy bucket.
examples.zh: 他转动曲柄把那只沉重的桶提了上来。

examples.en: The shepherd carried a long wooden crook.
examples.zh: 牧羊人拿着一根长长的木制曲柄杖。

examples.en: He became paranoid and thought everyone was watching him.
examples.zh: 他变得疑神疑鬼，觉得每个人都在监视他。

examples.en: Their new apartment is bright and very spacious.
examples.zh: 他们的新公寓明亮又非常宽敞。

examples.en: She rubbed some oil gently into her scalp.
examples.zh: 她把一些油轻轻地揉进她的头皮里。

examples.en: Water began to seep through the cracked wall.
examples.zh: 水开始从裂开的墙缝里渗出来。

examples.en: We had spicy chicken curry with rice for dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭我们吃了辛辣的鸡肉咖喱配米饭。

examples.en: From the hilltop we enjoyed a beautiful vista of the valley.
examples.zh: 从山顶上我们欣赏到了山谷的美丽景色。

examples.en: He added some sweet relish to his hot dog.
examples.zh: 他在热狗上加了一些甜味的调味酱。

examples.en: I will always cherish the memories of our trip.
examples.zh: 我会永远珍爱我们旅行的回忆。

examples.en: The detective slowly unraveled the mystery of the crime.
examples.zh: 侦探慢慢地解开了这起罪案的谜团。

examples.en: The volcanic eruption forced thousands of people to flee.
examples.zh: 火山喷发迫使成千上万的人逃离。

examples.en: Thou shalt not steal, the old commandment says.
examples.zh: 古老的诫命说，你不可偷盗。

examples.en: Many writers strongly oppose government censorship of books.
examples.zh: 许多作家强烈反对政府对书籍的审查制度。

examples.en: A tiny insect landed on his left eyelid.
examples.zh: 一只小虫落在了他的左眼皮上。

examples.en: The men tried to smuggle diamonds across the border.
examples.zh: 那些人试图把钻石走私过边境。

examples.en: Mobile phones are now commonplace in every home.
examples.zh: 如今手机在每个家庭里都很普遍。

examples.en: These false ads can easily mislead young customers.
examples.zh: 这些虚假广告很容易误导年轻顾客。

examples.en: He read a book to escape the boredom of waiting.
examples.zh: 他读了一本书来摆脱等待的无聊。

examples.en: She gave a clear and persuasive speech in class.
examples.zh: 她在课堂上做了一次清晰而有说服力的演讲。

examples.en: Close your eyes and visualize a quiet beach.
examples.zh: 闭上眼睛，想象一片宁静的海滩。

examples.en: She added fresh mint leaves to her cup of tea.
examples.zh: 她在茶杯里加了一些新鲜的薄荷叶。

examples.en: My brother is an avid reader of science books.
examples.zh: 我哥哥是个酷爱读科学书籍的人。

examples.en: Incidentally, I met your old teacher yesterday.
examples.zh: 顺便说一句，我昨天遇到了你的老老师。

examples.en: A delicious smell emanated from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房里散发出一股诱人的香味。

examples.en: Rich farmland surrounds the small village.
examples.zh: 肥沃的农田环绕着这个小村庄。

examples.en: Deregulation of the market increased competition among airlines.
examples.zh: 市场的放松管制加剧了航空公司之间的竞争。

examples.en: It is unrealistic to expect quick results so soon.
examples.zh: 这么快就期待立竿见影的结果是不切实际的。

examples.en: The contraction of the muscle caused sudden pain.
examples.zh: 肌肉的收缩引起了突然的疼痛。

examples.en: They hired a nanny to look after their twins.
examples.zh: 他们雇了一位保姆来照顾他们的双胞胎。

examples.en: The municipality plans to build a new public park.
examples.zh: 市政当局计划修建一座新的公共公园。

examples.en: The report contained several inaccurate figures.
examples.zh: 这份报告里有几个不准确的数字。

examples.en: A statue was built to commemorate the brave soldiers.
examples.zh: 人们建了一座雕像来纪念那些勇敢的士兵。

examples.en: Greek mythology is full of gods and heroes.
examples.zh: 希腊神话里充满了神明和英雄。

examples.en: The groom smiled happily as the bride walked in.
examples.zh: 新娘走进来时，新郎开心地笑了。

examples.en: The two events happened in simultaneous fashion.
examples.zh: 这两件事是同时发生的。

examples.en: His shoes were filthy after the long muddy walk.
examples.zh: 走过漫长泥泞的路后，他的鞋子脏极了。

examples.en: She did exceptionally well on the final exam.
examples.zh: 她在期末考试中表现得异常出色。

examples.en: We had to defer the meeting until next week.
examples.zh: 我们不得不把会议推迟到下周。

examples.en: The police quickly caught the attacker after the fight.
examples.zh: 打斗之后警察很快抓住了那名攻击者。

examples.en: The benefits of exercise far outweigh the effort.
examples.zh: 锻炼带来的好处远远超过所付出的努力。

examples.en: The car came to an abrupt stop at the corner.
examples.zh: 汽车在拐角处突然停了下来。

examples.en: Crime was rampant in that part of the city.
examples.zh: 在城市的那个地区，犯罪十分猖獗。

examples.en: This temple dates back to ancient antiquity.
examples.zh: 这座神庙可以追溯到遥远的古代。

examples.en: It's a wide generalization to say all students are lazy.
examples.zh: 说所有学生都懒惰是一种宽泛的概括。

examples.en: Soft green moss covered the old stone wall.
examples.zh: 柔软的绿色苔藓覆盖着那堵古老的石墙。

examples.en: The only downside of the job is the long hours.
examples.zh: 这份工作唯一的缺点就是工作时间长。

examples.en: The small village nestles between two green hills.
examples.zh: 这个小村庄安卧在两座青山之间。

examples.en: Support for the old software is now nonexistent.
examples.zh: 对那个旧软件的支持现在已经不存在了。

examples.en: She wore a stylish coat to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件时髦的外套去参加聚会。

examples.en: There wasn't a shred of evidence against him.
examples.zh: 没有一丝证据能证明他有罪。

examples.en: He works in the automotive industry as an engineer.
examples.zh: 他在汽车行业当工程师。

examples.en: The bus suddenly veered to the left to avoid a dog.
examples.zh: 公交车突然向左转向，以躲开一只狗。

examples.en: The tabloid printed a shocking story about the actor.
examples.zh: 那家小报刊登了一则关于那位演员的耸人听闻的消息。

examples.en: She found great fulfillment in helping sick children.
examples.zh: 她在帮助生病的孩子中找到了极大的满足感。

examples.en: We turned on the heater to warm the cold room.
examples.zh: 我们打开加热器让寒冷的房间暖和起来。

examples.en: Party leaders held a caucus to choose their candidate.
examples.zh: 党的领导人召开核心会议来挑选他们的候选人。

examples.en: Grandma takes herbs for her common ailments.
examples.zh: 奶奶用草药治她那些常见的小病。

examples.en: We heard loud gunfire coming from the street.
examples.zh: 我们听到街上传来响亮的枪声。

examples.en: The old novel describes a woman forced to whore for money.
examples.zh: 那本旧小说描写了一个被迫卖淫赚钱的女人。

examples.en: The wedding cake had three white tiers.
examples.zh: 那个婚礼蛋糕有三层白色的。

examples.en: Amazingly, he finished the whole race without resting.
examples.zh: 令人惊讶的是，他没休息就跑完了整场比赛。

examples.en: After many years, the brothers finally reunited.
examples.zh: 多年之后，兄弟俩终于重聚了。

examples.en: The police searched the whole city for the fugitive.
examples.zh: 警察搜遍了整座城市来寻找那名逃犯。

examples.en: She felt the loud music was an intrusion on her peace.
examples.zh: 她觉得吵闹的音乐打扰了她的安宁。

examples.en: This versatile tool can be used for many jobs.
examples.zh: 这件多用途的工具可以用于许多工作。

examples.en: A whole battalion marched through the town.
examples.zh: 整整一营士兵穿过了这座城镇。

examples.en: Silicon is widely used to make semiconductor chips.
examples.zh: 硅被广泛用于制造半导体芯片。

examples.en: The village has remained almost unchanged for decades.
examples.zh: 几十年来这个村庄几乎没有变化。

examples.en: The barking dog next door is a real nuisance.
examples.zh: 隔壁那只狂吠的狗真是个讨厌的东西。

examples.en: She felt dizzy after spinning around so quickly.
examples.zh: 快速转圈之后她感到头晕。

examples.en: We heard the distant rumble of thunder.
examples.zh: 我们听到远处雷声的隆隆作响。

examples.en: This peach is sweet and very juicy.
examples.zh: 这个桃子又甜又多汁。

examples.en: Each contestant had two minutes to answer the question.
examples.zh: 每位参赛者有两分钟时间回答问题。

examples.en: His rude remark was clearly intentional, not a mistake.
examples.zh: 他无礼的话显然是故意的，不是失误。

examples.en: The dog gave a low growl at the stranger.
examples.zh: 那条狗对陌生人发出低沉的咆哮声。

examples.en: He put some hair gel on before going out.
examples.zh: 出门前他抹了一些发胶。

examples.en: The factory tests the purity of its drinking water.
examples.zh: 这家工厂检测其饮用水的纯净度。

examples.en: She opened an account at a small brokerage firm.
examples.zh: 她在一家小型经纪公司开了一个账户。

examples.en: He sank a difficult putt to win the game.
examples.zh: 他打进一记艰难的推杆赢得了比赛。

examples.en: The sick child began to vomit after lunch.
examples.zh: 那个生病的孩子午饭后开始呕吐。

examples.en: The singer tapped the mike before she started.
examples.zh: 歌手在开始之前轻敲了一下话筒。

examples.en: The teacher reiterated the rules before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前老师重申了考场规则。

examples.en: We danced to the rhythmic beat of the drums.
examples.zh: 我们随着鼓点有节奏的节拍跳舞。

examples.en: The old shelf began to sag under the heavy books.
examples.zh: 在沉重的书本下，那个旧书架开始往下垂。

examples.en: She searched frantically for her lost keys.
examples.zh: 她疯狂地寻找她丢失的钥匙。

examples.en: The children chattered endlessly during the trip.
examples.zh: 旅途中孩子们没完没了地聊个不停。

examples.en: They painted the exterior of the house white.
examples.zh: 他们把房子的外部漆成了白色。

examples.en: We spent a delightful afternoon in the garden.
examples.zh: 我们在花园里度过了一个愉快的下午。

examples.en: She used conditioner to make her hair soft.
examples.zh: 她用护发素让头发变得柔软。

examples.en: The police seized a large amount of illicit drugs.
examples.zh: 警方缴获了大量的非法毒品。

examples.en: He lives in perpetual fear of losing his job.
examples.zh: 他生活在失去工作的无尽恐惧之中。

examples.en: They built a makeshift shelter from old boards.
examples.zh: 他们用旧木板搭了一个临时的栖身处。

examples.en: She visited the village as a sign of goodwill.
examples.zh: 她拜访这个村庄以表达善意。

examples.en: The manager denied any wrongdoing in the case.
examples.zh: 经理否认在这件事中有任何不当行为。

examples.en: Running is a good form of aerobic exercise.
examples.zh: 跑步是一种很好的有氧运动。

examples.en: As a skeptic, he doubted the strange story.
examples.zh: 作为一个怀疑论者，他对这个奇怪的故事表示怀疑。

examples.en: The agents carried out a covert mission at night.
examples.zh: 特工们在夜间执行了一项秘密任务。

examples.en: We discussed every facet of the new plan.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了这个新计划的每一个方面。

examples.en: The two countries agreed to disarm their forces.
examples.zh: 两国同意解除各自军队的武装。

examples.en: She beckoned the waiter to bring the bill.
examples.zh: 她招手示意服务员把账单拿过来。

examples.en: When he forgot his lines, he had to improvise.
examples.zh: 他忘词的时候只好临时即兴发挥。

examples.en: He put on his warm slippers at home.
examples.zh: 他在家里穿上了暖和的拖鞋。

examples.en: She decided to freelance instead of taking a full-time job.
examples.zh: 她决定做自由职业，而不是找一份全职工作。

examples.en: The champion easily defeated his young challenger.
examples.zh: 冠军轻松地击败了他年轻的挑战者。

examples.en: She announced her candidacy for mayor last week.
examples.zh: 上周她宣布了自己竞选市长的候选资格。

examples.en: His preoccupation with money worried his family.
examples.zh: 他对金钱的执着让家人很担心。

examples.en: We had a short quiz at the start of class.
examples.zh: 上课一开始我们做了一个简短的小测验。

examples.en: It is illegal to carry a handgun without a license.
examples.zh: 没有执照携带手枪是违法的。

examples.en: We bought some chuck to make a beef stew.
examples.zh: 我们买了一些牛颈肉来炖牛肉。

examples.en: Driving that fast in the rain is almost suicidal.
examples.zh: 在雨中开那么快几乎是自杀行为。

examples.en: The chicken was served with a rich chocolate mole.
examples.zh: 这道鸡肉配的是浓郁的巧克力辣酱。

examples.en: The shop sells a wide assortment of candies.
examples.zh: 这家店出售种类繁多的糖果。

examples.en: Heavy snow can impede the progress of the trains.
examples.zh: 大雪会阻碍火车的运行。

examples.en: He gave a wince of pain when he touched the wound.
examples.zh: 碰到伤口时他疼得脸一缩。

examples.en: We waited for the storm to subside before leaving.
examples.zh: 我们等暴风雨平息后才离开。

examples.en: He plays for a popular collegiate basketball team.
examples.zh: 他效力于一支受欢迎的大学篮球队。

examples.en: The charity gives food to needy families every winter.
examples.zh: 这家慈善机构每年冬天给贫困家庭发放食物。

examples.en: The first baseman caught the ball just in time.
examples.zh: 一垒手及时接住了球。

examples.en: She studies engineering in the aerospace department.
examples.zh: 她在航空航天系学习工程学。

examples.en: Scientists hypothesize that the planet once had water.
examples.zh: 科学家们假设这颗行星曾经有过水。

examples.en: The report was shared only internally within the company.
examples.zh: 这份报告只在公司内部传阅。

examples.en: She is an outspoken critic of the new law.
examples.zh: 她是这项新法律的直言不讳的批评者。

examples.en: There is a clear differential between the two prices.
examples.zh: 两种价格之间存在明显的差别。

examples.en: A single rose petal fell onto the table.
examples.zh: 一片玫瑰花瓣落到了桌上。

examples.en: The team made a geological survey of the area.
examples.zh: 团队对该地区进行了地质勘测。

examples.en: The vaccine helps the body produce antibodies.
examples.zh: 疫苗帮助身体产生抗体。

examples.en: Colorful graffiti covered the old subway walls.
examples.zh: 五颜六色的涂鸦覆盖了地铁的旧墙。

examples.en: His speech was full of tired old cliches.
examples.zh: 他的演讲充满了陈词滥调。

examples.en: Nothing grows on this dry and barren land.
examples.zh: 这片干燥贫瘠的土地上什么都长不出来。

examples.en: The door squeaked because the hinge needed oil.
examples.zh: 门吱吱作响，因为铰链需要上油了。

examples.en: The company has a strict hierarchical structure.
examples.zh: 这家公司有着严格的等级结构。

examples.en: Stars and planets are celestial bodies.
examples.zh: 恒星和行星都是天体。

examples.en: This lab is at the forefront of medical research.
examples.zh: 这个实验室处于医学研究的最前沿。

examples.en: He clenched his fists in anger.
examples.zh: 他愤怒地紧握双拳。

examples.en: She got her long hair cut into a neat bob.
examples.zh: 她把长发剪成了齐整的短发型。

examples.en: Please check the timetable for the next train.
examples.zh: 请查看时间表上下一班火车的时间。

examples.en: She was tired of her mundane daily routine.
examples.zh: 她厌倦了平淡乏味的日常生活。

examples.en: We picked fresh raspberries in the summer garden.
examples.zh: 夏天我们在花园里采摘新鲜的覆盆子。

examples.en: Her family attends a small Presbyterian church.
examples.zh: 她的家人在一座小的长老会教堂做礼拜。

examples.en: It is prudent to save some money for emergencies.
examples.zh: 存一些钱以备不时之需是明智的。

examples.en: The company spokesperson answered the reporters' questions.
examples.zh: 公司发言人回答了记者们的提问。

examples.en: Rescuers searched the wreckage for survivors.
examples.zh: 救援人员在残骸中搜寻幸存者。

examples.en: The decision to accept the plan was unanimous.
examples.zh: 接受这个计划的决定是一致通过的。

examples.en: Write down the address lest you forget it.
examples.zh: 把地址记下来，以免你忘了。

examples.en: They drank some beer at the old village tavern.
examples.zh: 他们在古老的村庄酒馆里喝了点啤酒。

examples.en: The assassin was caught before he could escape.
examples.zh: 刺客在逃走之前就被抓住了。

examples.en: The room smelled fresh because of the cedar wood.
examples.zh: 因为有雪松木，房间里散发着清新的气味。

examples.en: The artist etched a small bird onto the glass.
examples.zh: 艺术家在玻璃上蚀刻了一只小鸟。

examples.en: She played a soft tune on her silver flute.
examples.zh: 她用她的银笛吹奏了一首柔和的曲子。

examples.en: He takes a short walk on a nightly basis.
examples.zh: 他每晚都散一会儿步。

examples.en: The meeting was a continuation of last week's talk.
examples.zh: 这次会议是上周谈话的延续。

examples.en: This class is perfect for a complete beginner.
examples.zh: 这门课非常适合完全的初学者。

examples.en: He drove dangerously fast on the wet road.
examples.zh: 他在湿滑的路上开得危险地快。

examples.en: We ate popcorn while watching the movie.
examples.zh: 看电影的时候我们吃了爆米花。

examples.en: She smeared some butter on the warm bread.
examples.zh: 她在热面包上涂了一些黄油。

examples.en: A group of rebels tried to assassinate the king.
examples.zh: 一群叛乱者企图暗杀国王。

examples.en: The liberalization of trade opened new markets.
examples.zh: 贸易自由化开辟了新的市场。

examples.en: The broken watch was completely worthless.
examples.zh: 那只坏掉的手表完全没有价值。

examples.en: People admired her sharp intellect and quick mind.
examples.zh: 人们钦佩她敏锐的才智和灵活的头脑。

examples.en: The baby gently sucked on the bottle's nipple.
examples.zh: 婴儿轻轻地吮吸着奶瓶的奶嘴。

examples.en: Many families fled the country to escape persecution.
examples.zh: 许多家庭逃离这个国家以躲避迫害。

examples.en: They rejected the offer outright.
examples.zh: 他们完全拒绝了这个提议。

examples.en: The team improved tremendously after months of practice.
examples.zh: 经过几个月的练习后，这支队伍进步巨大。
